name: No / weak customer due diligence
description: Identity verification thin; beneficial ownership not documented; relationship purpose not captured.

name: No transaction monitoring
description: No automated rules; reliance on staff to spot suspicious activity in the moment.

name: No EDD trigger or refresh policy
description: PEPs and high-risk customers handled identically to standard.

name: No TF-specific rule set or intel feed
description: TF-specific patterns (small structured outflows, sanctioned charities, conflict zones) not detected.

name: No PEP / sanctions / adverse-media screening
description: Counterparties not screened against PEP / sanctions / adverse-media lists.

name: No STR / SAR pathway
description: No documented escalation path to the FIU; no templates retained; tipping-off rules unknown to staff.
